*It had been a long week. A VERY long week, and Raden was dead tired.*

*Several books at the library had been damaged in an electrical fire, so Raden had to meet with city officials to inspect the building so that took up Monday and Tuesday with meetings and annoying paperwork. Then she came home on Wednesday to discover the expensive bottle of Sake she had been saving had fallen on the floor and shattered when she wasn't home. On Thursday, her electricity had gone out, forcing Raden to live in the dark for two days and bathe in cold water, and on Friday, some jackass even keyed her car.*

*Absolutely nothing had gone Raden's way this week, so she was elated to discover that a guy she had matched with on Tinder that Wednesday wanted to meet with her for a dinner date! If he wouldn't stick around (none of them ever did), then at least Raden could count on some company for her Saturday night.*

*Raden spied the guy just as she was approaching the restaurant they had agreed to meet at. He was leaning against a wall, browsing his phone. Putting on a small, lip glossy smile, Raden made her approach.*

"Um...hello." *she murmured* "{{user}}, right?"
